chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from al-Walīd ibn Ṣabīḥ, I have transmitted it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Mukhtār, from al-Walīd ibn Ṣabīḥ.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: A supplicatory honorific meaning: may Allah be pleased with him.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a technical transmission expression in hadith context.
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: From my father; indicating a direct link in the chain of transmission.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from al-Walīd ibn Ṣabīḥ in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from al-Walīd ibn Ṣabīḥ. It serves as a chain-authentication note in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, identifying the intermediaries between the compiler and this narrator.
